page_template.$comment: Generated at load time from the slot model in klartex/page_templates.py (page_template_schema); see registry.py.

meeting_type.description: Type of meeting, e.g. Styrelsemöte, Årsmöte

title.description: Agenda item title. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.

discussion.description: Discussion text. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.

decision.description: Decision text. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.

subItems.description: Optional sub-items with decimal sub-numbering under the item (1.1., 1.2., …), rendered after the item's discussion and decision. Inline markup applies: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, "quotes", and the change markers {+added text+} (green) / [-removed text-] (red strikethrough). A newline becomes a line break.
